aviation_incidents.headline: 巴布亞紐幾內亞航空波音767客機發動機火警指示轉降菲律賓達沃
aviation_incidents.summary: 巴布亞紐幾內亞航空PX19航班波音767-300ER（註冊號P2-PXW）自香港國際機場飛往莫士比港傑克遜國際機場，於33000呎巡航、達沃東北方約160海里處，機組接獲右側普惠PW4060發動機火警指示。機組依緊急程序關閉並隔離受影響發動機，轉降達沃國際機場，於11月21日當地時間約凌晨0時08分降落05跑道，距接獲指示約45分鐘。巴布亞紐幾內亞航空其後證實機組在轉降前已關閉該發動機，飛機安全落地。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Air Niugini Boeing 767 diverts to Davao after engine fire warning
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Air Niugini flight PX19, a Boeing 767-300ER registered P2-PXW, was flying from Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) to Port Moresby Jacksons International Airport (POM) when the crew received a fire indication on the right Pratt & Whitney PW4060 engine while cruising at FL330 about 160 nautical miles northeast of Davao. The crew shut down and secured the affected engine under emergency procedures and diverted to Davao International Airport, landing on runway 05 at about 00:08 a.m. local time on November 21, roughly 45 minutes after the indication. Air Niugini later confirmed the engine had been shut down before the diversion and that the aircraft landed safely.

aviation_incidents.headline: 加拿大航空波音 737 MAX 8 據報在棕櫚泉離場爬升時收到 TCAS 避讓指令
aviation_incidents.summary: 航空媒體 AeroSillage 與 Simple Flying 引述 AIRLIVE 報導，加拿大航空 AC1769 航班於11月17日自美國加州棕櫚泉國際機場（PSP）起飛，前往溫哥華國際機場（YVR）。飛機爬升至約11,400呎時，空中防撞系統（TCAS）發出避讓指令（Resolution Advisory），要求機組爬升至12,000呎。報導稱，當時附近一架塞斯納（Cessna）小飛機沒有回應。涉事飛機為波音 737 MAX 8，註冊號 C-FSDB。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Air Canada Boeing 737 MAX 8 reportedly received TCAS climb advisory after departing Palm Springs
aviation_incidents.summary_en: AeroSillage and Simple Flying, citing AIRLIVE, reported that Air Canada flight AC1769 departed Palm Springs International Airport (PSP) for Vancouver International Airport (YVR) on November 17. As the aircraft climbed through about 11,400 feet, its Traffic Collision Avoidance System (TCAS) issued a resolution advisory calling for a climb to 12,000 feet. A nearby Cessna was reportedly not responding. The aircraft was a Boeing 737 MAX 8 registered C-FSDB.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 民航局舉辦無人機與先進空中交通論壇 邀國外專家交流
taiwan_aviation.summary: 交通部民用航空局11月23日舉辦「2026國際無人機及先進空中交通論壇」。論壇聚焦國際無人機與先進空中交通（AAM）發展，以及國際航空安全規範介紹，並邀請國外民航主管機關與專家分享實務經驗。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration holds drone and advanced air mobility forum
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration held the 2026 international forum on drones and advanced air mobility (AAM) on November 23. The forum focused on international drone and AAM development and international aviation safety standards, with overseas civil aviation authorities and experts invited to share practical experience.

new_information: The 2026 international forum on drones and advanced air mobility opened on November 23.
The Civil Aeronautics Administration organised the forum to help Taiwan's drone industry and systems align internationally through foreign experts' contributions.
The forum's stated topics were international drone and advanced air mobility development and an introduction to international aviation safety standards.
Overseas civil aviation authorities and experts were invited to share practical experience.
AAM needs airworthiness certification, safety oversight and airspace integration mechanisms to move from research and development to practical operations.
Electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft are among the emerging technologies that could expand urban and regional transport, emergency rescue and remote-area transport services.

international_aviation.headline: 比利時全國示威衝擊航班：布魯塞爾與沙勒羅瓦機場11月23日多數航班取消
international_aviation.summary: 布魯塞爾機場（BRU）預計11月23日出現大規模航班中斷。比利時飛航服務商skeyes部分航管人員將加入全國示威，skeyes屆時無法提供正常飛航管制服務，機場表示多數進出港航班必須取消，中斷時間為當地時間7時至21時。
international_aviation.headline_en: Belgian strike to ground most flights at Brussels and Charleroi airports on November 23
international_aviation.summary_en: Brussels Airport (BRU) expects major flight disruption on November 23, after some air traffic controllers at Belgian air navigation service provider skeyes said they would join a national demonstration. The airport said most arriving and departing flights will have to be cancelled because skeyes will not be able to provide normal air traffic control services during the action, with disruption expected from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. local time (6 a.m. to 8 p.m. UTC).

international_aviation.headline: 達美航空見習副機師滑行中接電話據報遭解僱
international_aviation.summary: 據播客節目Black Box Aviation Podcast轉述，一名達美航空見習副機師在初始操作經驗（IOE）訓練期間執行首趟上線航班，飛機由亞特蘭大滑行準備起飛時，他的手機響起，他在機長滑行期間接聽了電話。機長隨即返回登機門，將該名副機師請下飛機，其後該名副機師遭到解僱。
international_aviation.headline_en: Delta trainee pilot reportedly dismissed after answering phone while taxiing
international_aviation.summary_en: A Delta Air Lines first officer on new-hire training reportedly lost his job after answering his cellphone while the aircraft was taxiing for departure, according to an account shared on the Black Box Aviation Podcast. The captain is said to have returned to the gate rather than continue to the runway, and the first officer was removed from the aircraft and later dismissed. The podcast's social post places the incident in Atlanta and calls it the new hire's first trip on the line.

international_aviation.headline: 澳洲航空啟動機隊換裝：以空中巴士A321XLR飛機汰換波音737-800
international_aviation.summary: 澳洲航空在機隊更新計畫「溫頓計畫」下，以空中巴士A321XLR汰換波音737-800，做為國內線高運量主力機型；該計畫名稱取自澳洲航空1920年創立地昆士蘭州溫頓。737機隊每年載運近半數澳航旅客，換裝將牽動澳洲最繁忙的國內幹線。A321XLR訂單從最初至少20架增至28架，澳洲航空2025年8月再增訂20架，總數達48架；澳航已在2026財政年度接收6架A321XLR，737退役自2026年底展開。
international_aviation.headline_en: Qantas to replace Boeing 737-800s with Airbus A321XLRs under Project Winton
international_aviation.summary_en: Qantas is replacing its Boeing 737-800s with the Airbus A321XLR as its main high-capacity domestic replacement under Project Winton, its fleet renewal program named for Winton, Queensland, where Qantas was founded in 1920. The 737 fleet carries nearly half of all passengers Qantas flies each year, so the change affects its busiest domestic corridors. The A321XLR order grew from an initial plan for at least 20 aircraft to 28, and Qantas ordered 20 more in August 2025, bringing the total to 48. Qantas took six A321XLRs during its 2026 financial year, ahead of 737 retirements beginning in late 2026.
